school: School of Disaster Response & Crisis Intervention
title: Climate Justice & Resilient Communities
outcome: Use a rights-based, community-led approach to identify climate-related social inequities, strengthen adaptive capacity, and support accountable climate action within a professional role.

modules.title: Climate risk, inequity, and rights
modules.focus: unequal exposure, vulnerability, livelihoods, displacement, health, disability inclusion, gender, participation, and human dignity

modules.title: Community-led adaptation and resilient services
modules.focus: local knowledge, accessible planning, social protection, livelihoods, community assets, inclusion, and adaptation partnerships

modules.title: Just transition, advocacy, and accountability
modules.focus: climate decisions, distribution of benefits and burdens, community voice, responsible evidence use, monitoring, and constructive advocacy
